scope: Shared Choose Plan presentation used by onboarding and existing paywall entrances; no payment or backend rule changes.
display: Cream background, centered bunny and heading, two white plan cards with selected brown outline
Yearly Best Deal badge only when the same-currency annual price is lower than twelve monthly payments
Store-provided total price for two users
Per-user monthly estimate: yearly numeric price divided by 24; monthly numeric price divided by 2; currency precision rounding
Trial tag and CTA depend on actual store eligibility and duration
Disclosure follows selected plan and the same actual store display price
priceSource: Existing expo-iap fetchProducts(type=subs): iOS StoreKit products; Android Play Billing selected offer's final recurring phase. Not hard-coded screenshot values and not direct administrative-console scraping.

validation.nativeVisual: iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 26.2, isolated native Release host using actual presentation and loaded Inter fonts; yearly and monthly selected states visually inspected; selected outline, CTA and disclosure change together.
validation.nativeFixture: USD 39.99/year and 6.99/month, 3-day eligible trial. These are QA inputs, not a verification of the user's live store prices. Purchase/restore handlers were inert; no transaction occurred.
validation.paymentBodies: Existing purchase, restore, receipt processing, eligibility and offer-selection function bodies remain byte-for-byte unchanged, checked by existing golden hashes. Currency formatting was moved into one shared presentation helper without changing its formatting behavior.

deployment: No API/Admin/database deployment or App Store release performed. Client changes require the normal client delivery process.
limitations: No real StoreKit/Play purchase or Android device visual test performed in this UI change.
Store configuration propagation and product availability remain controlled by the stores; unavailable prices still block checkout and expose retry.
